identity: 中國文化大學 大孝館暨體育館（2005 新複合體）
scope: One composite historical approximate massing and observed-color study; not measured as-built and not 2026 condition.
source_era: EXIF 2005 / 2017 / 2019 and undated architect photographs; composite, not a single-date reconstruction
units: Output coordinates are display-model millimetres. All geometry values below are illustrative normalized/photo-fitted parameters, NOT real-building measurements or an asserted scale ratio.

documented.caution: 50 x 70 m describes sports halls, not outer ellipse axes. No 50 x 75 m outer-envelope measurement is asserted.

north_arm.height_mapping: 10-storey portion inferred; heights not uniform measured floors

east_arm.height_mapping: 8-storey portion inferred; heights not uniform measured floors

fitted.status: Photo-fitted silhouette / schematic-map topology. Exact L lengths, ellipse rotation, core position, heights and roof curvature remain inferred.

entrance_recess.status: Photo-supported recessed portal, dimensions and placement photo-fitted; omit door/sign detail

observation_map.angle_convention: Ellipse local +x is zero; counterclockwise in local xy, then rotated by fitted.rotation_deg. Not compass directions.
observation_map.upper_sectors_note: Relative locations are a conservative visual assignment from undated terrace views, not surveyed facade registration. Remaining crown sector is neutral.
observation_map.unknown: Inner L faces, junction, end closures, unseen sports sector, roof hidden continuation and undersides: plain neutral; no invented rear fenestration or equipment.

warnings: Overhanging eaves and upper colonnades can require supports.
